purpose: Verify user enrolled, assigned, or linked to a course is granted access to the course workspace
preconditions: Course C101 exists; user U1 has an active course association (student, faculty, TA, or observer)
action_or_input: User U1 requests access to course C101 workspace
expected_result: System validates course-specific association and grants access with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify user without course association is denied access to the course workspace
preconditions: Course C101 exists; user U2 has no enrollment, assignment, or linkage to C101
action_or_input: User U2 requests access to course C101 workspace
expected_result: System denies access with HTTP 403 or 404; no course content is disclosed

purpose: Verify Student course access is permitted based on authoritative registration data
preconditions: Student S1 has an authoritative course enrollment record in course C101
action_or_input: Student S1 accesses course home and syllabus for C101
expected_result: System verifies registration data and returns course data with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify Student not registered in course is rejected from accessing student course endpoints
preconditions: Student S2 exists in identity system but is not registered in course C101
action_or_input: Student S2 requests course home, assignments, or materials for C101
expected_result: System denies access with HTTP 403 or 404

purpose: Verify linked Observer can view course details, published materials, and announcements
preconditions: Observer O1 is linked to course C101; course has published materials and announcements
action_or_input: Observer O1 retrieves course details, announcements, and published materials for C101
expected_result: System returns read-only course details, announcements, and materials with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify Observer is forbidden from performing any write action in course
preconditions: Observer O1 is linked to course C101
action_or_input: Observer O1 attempts to create material, post announcement, create assignment, or grade
expected_result: System rejects write action with HTTP 403; no state change occurs

purpose: Verify Observer cannot view individual student submissions, grades, or private student data
preconditions: Observer O1 is linked to course C101; students have submitted assignments with grades
action_or_input: Observer O1 requests student submission list, specific submission, or gradebook
expected_result: System denies access to student-specific data with HTTP 403; returns empty or forbidden

purpose: Verify TA can view course content, view submissions, and record draft grades
preconditions: TA T1 is assigned to course C101; submissions exist for assignment A1
action_or_input: TA T1 views submissions and submits draft grade for student submission Sub1
expected_result: System accepts TA draft grade and returns HTTP 200 or 201

purpose: Verify TA is prohibited from creating or editing assignments
preconditions: TA T1 is assigned to course C101
action_or_input: TA T1 attempts to create a new assignment or update existing assignment details
expected_result: System denies assignment authoring with HTTP 403; assignment remains unchanged

purpose: Verify TA is prohibited from creating, updating, or deleting course materials or structure
preconditions: TA T1 is assigned to course C101
action_or_input: TA T1 attempts to upload course material or edit course details
expected_result: System denies material authoring with HTTP 403; course content remains unchanged

purpose: Verify published course material is visible to authorized students, TAs, and observers
preconditions: Material M1 in C101 is in Published state; Student S1 is enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 requests course materials list or material details for M1
expected_result: System returns published material metadata and content with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify unpublished or draft course material is invisible to Students and Observers
preconditions: Material M2 in C101 is in Unpublished / Draft state; Student S1 is enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 requests materials list or material details for M2
expected_result: System omits M2 from list and denies direct detail access with HTTP 403 or 404

purpose: Verify course material configured with future release date remains unavailable before release time
preconditions: Material M3 has release_at timestamp set to tomorrow; current time < release_at
action_or_input: Student S1 attempts to view or download material M3
expected_result: System withholds material M3; request returns HTTP 403 or 404

purpose: Verify scheduled material becomes published and available when configured release timestamp is reached
preconditions: Material M3 release timestamp has arrived; scheduled release task has executed
action_or_input: Student S1 requests material M3 details
expected_result: System provides access to released material with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify assigned Faculty can post course announcements
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 posts announcement with title 'Exam Notice' and content
expected_result: System creates announcement and returns HTTP 201

purpose: Verify TA with posting permission can post course announcements
preconditions: TA T1 in C101 has announcement posting authority enabled
action_or_input: TA T1 posts announcement with title 'Lab Timings' and content
expected_result: System validates permission, creates announcement, and returns HTTP 201

purpose: Verify TA without permission or Student cannot post course announcements
preconditions: Student S1 or TA T2 without posting permission attempts to post
action_or_input: User attempts to post announcement to C101
expected_result: System rejects posting request with HTTP 403; no announcement is created

purpose: Verify posted announcement has server timestamp and is visible to all course members
preconditions: Announcement Ann1 posted in C101; Student S1 and Faculty F1 belong to C101
action_or_input: Student S1 views course announcements list
expected_result: System returns Ann1 with non-null timestamp, author identity, and content with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify course announcement is not exposed to non-course members
preconditions: Announcement Ann1 posted in C101; user U3 has no affiliation with C101
action_or_input: User U3 attempts to retrieve announcements for C101
expected_result: System rejects request with HTTP 403 or 404

purpose: Verify assignment with valid title, due date, instructions, submission type, and points possible is accepted
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 creates assignment providing title='Lab 1', due_date in future, instructions='Follow spec', submission_type='file', points_possible=50
expected_result: System validates all required fields and saves assignment returning HTTP 201

purpose: Verify assignment creation without due date is rejected
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 creates assignment omitting due_date
expected_result: System rejects request with HTTP 400; assignment is not created

purpose: Verify assignment creation without valid submission type is rejected
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 creates assignment with missing or invalid submission_type
expected_result: System rejects request with HTTP 400; assignment is not created

purpose: Verify assignment creation with negative or zero points possible is rejected
preconditions: Faculty F1 is assigned to course C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 creates assignment with points_possible=-10 or 0
expected_result: System rejects request with HTTP 400; assignment is not created

purpose: Verify assignment remains in Draft state after creation until explicitly published
preconditions: Faculty F1 created assignment A1 without publish action; A1 is in Draft state
action_or_input: Student S1 queries assignments for C101
expected_result: Draft assignment A1 is omitted from Student S1 view; cannot be submitted to

purpose: Verify assignment transitions to Published state only when Faculty publishes it
preconditions: Assignment A1 in C101 is in Draft state; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 invokes publish action on assignment A1
expected_result: System transitions assignment status to Published with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify published assignment configured with future release date is withheld from students until release date
preconditions: Assignment A2 is Published with future release_at; Student S1 is enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 requests assignments list or details for A2
expected_result: Assignment A2 is withheld from Student S1; direct request returns HTTP 403 or 404

purpose: Verify published assignment whose release condition is satisfied is visible and accessible to students
preconditions: Assignment A1 has release condition satisfied (immediate or release_at reached)
action_or_input: Student S1 requests assignment details for A1
expected_result: System exposes assignment details and submission capability with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify submission conforming to configured 'file' type is accepted
preconditions: Assignment A_file has submission_type='file'; Student S1 is enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 submits valid file upload payload
expected_result: System accepts submission and returns HTTP 201

purpose: Verify submission conforming to configured 'text' type is accepted
preconditions: Assignment A_text has submission_type='text'; Student S1 is enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 submits non-empty text content
expected_result: System accepts submission and returns HTTP 201

purpose: Verify submission conforming to configured 'link' type with valid URL is accepted
preconditions: Assignment A_link has submission_type='link'; Student S1 is enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 submits valid URL link 'https://github.com/project'
expected_result: System accepts submission and returns HTTP 201

purpose: Verify submission with mismatched or malformed payload type is rejected
preconditions: Assignment A_file requires 'file' submission; Student S1 is enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 attempts to submit raw text without file
expected_result: System rejects submission with HTTP 400 or 422; no submission recorded

purpose: Verify submission submitted prior to due date is accepted and marked on-time
preconditions: Assignment A1 has due date in future; Student S1 is enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 submits valid assignment content before due date
expected_result: System records submission with current timestamp and on-time status with HTTP 201

purpose: Verify Student can view own submission history and status
preconditions: Student S1 submitted assignment A1
action_or_input: Student S1 requests submission history for assignment A1
expected_result: System returns Student S1's own submission data with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify Student cannot view another Student's submission history or files
preconditions: Student S1 submitted Sub1; Student S2 is another student enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S2 requests details or file of submission Sub1
expected_result: System denies access with HTTP 403 or 404; no submission data disclosed

purpose: Verify Faculty grading records grader attribution and timestamp
preconditions: Submission Sub1 exists in C101; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 grades Sub1 with points=45 and feedback='Good'
expected_result: System stores grade record attributing grader_user_id to F1 with timestamp; returns HTTP 200 or 201

purpose: Verify TA grading records grader attribution and timestamp
preconditions: Submission Sub1 exists in C101; TA T1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: TA T1 grades Sub1 with points=40 and feedback='Adequate'
expected_result: System stores grade record attributing grader_user_id to T1 with timestamp; returns HTTP 200 or 201

purpose: Verify student, observer, or unassigned user is rejected when attempting to grade
preconditions: User U7 is not Faculty or TA for course C101; submission Sub1 exists
action_or_input: User U7 attempts to enter grade for Sub1
expected_result: System denies grading request with HTTP 403; grade remains unrecorded

purpose: Verify grader is prohibited from grading their own submission
preconditions: User is a TA in C101 but also submitted work Sub_self as an enrolled student
action_or_input: User attempts to grade Sub_self
expected_result: System rejects request with HTTP 403 or 422 (CANNOT_GRADE_OWN_SUBMISSION)

purpose: Verify draft grades and feedback remain invisible to the submitting student
preconditions: Draft grade G_draft exists for Student S1's submission Sub1
action_or_input: Student S1 requests their grade for assignment A1
expected_result: System withholds draft grade points and feedback from Student S1; status shown as ungraded / submitted

purpose: Verify released grades and feedback become visible to the submitting student
preconditions: Grade G_rel for Student S1's submission has been Released
action_or_input: Student S1 requests their grade for assignment A1
expected_result: System returns released grade points and feedback with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify assigned Faculty has authority to release draft grades
preconditions: Draft grades exist in C101; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 executes grade release for assignment A1
expected_result: System marks applicable grades as Released and returns HTTP 200

purpose: Verify TA does not have authority to release grades
preconditions: Draft grades exist in C101; TA T1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: TA T1 attempts to trigger grade release for assignment A1
expected_result: System denies grade release with HTTP 403; draft grades remain unreleased

purpose: Verify Student can view released grade in read-only form
preconditions: Grade G_rel for Student S1 is Released; Student S1 is enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 retrieves their released grade
expected_result: System returns grade and feedback with HTTP 200

purpose: Verify Student is denied from modifying or tampering with released grade
preconditions: Grade G_rel for Student S1 is Released; Student S1 is enrolled in C101
action_or_input: Student S1 attempts PUT/PATCH request to update points or feedback of G_rel
expected_result: System rejects modification with HTTP 403; grade data remains unchanged

purpose: Verify changing an already released grade creates an audit trail entry with actor and timestamp
preconditions: Grade G_rel for Sub1 is in Released state; Faculty F1 is assigned to C101
action_or_input: Faculty F1 modifies points of G_rel from 40 to 45 with justification
expected_result: System persists modified grade and creates audit record storing actor_id, prior grade, new grade, and timestamp; returns HTTP 200
